title: Sync Shopify products and inventory into Airtable
subtitle: Intermediate Data Sync & Integration workflow for E-commerce & Retail
short: On every Shopify product change, upserts one Airtable row per variant carrying its SKU, price and inventory quantity.

title: Push Airtable product edits to Shopify
subtitle: Intermediate Data Sync & Integration workflow for E-commerce & Retail
short: When a row changes in an Airtable products table, pushes the edited title, tags and status to the matching Shopify product.

title: Sync an Airtable product catalog to Shopify on a schedule
subtitle: Advanced Data Sync & Integration workflow for E-commerce & Retail
short: Each hour, reads products flagged 'Sync' in an Airtable catalog and updates the matching Shopify products' title, tags and status in a throttled batch.
